environment.description: AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (REST API) with Split.io SDK. The Split workspace has the flag 'legacy-tracking-pixel-v2' configured with definition targeting: default rule serves 'off', individual targeting has zero entries, percentage rollout set to 0% for 'on' treatment. The flag's 'kill switch' is NOT engaged (flag is active), and the default treatment in code fallback (SDK timeout/error) is configured via SPLIT_DEFAULT_TREATMENT env var as 'off'. The Split relay proxy is deployed as a sidecar with local evaluation mode, meaning flag definitions are cached and evaluated locally without network dependency. Note: the API Gateway stage does NOT have response header validation enabled, and no WAF is attached to this deployment.

config.split_relay_proxy: local evaluation sidecar, definitions synced every 60s
config.note: Flag evaluation occurs in-process via cached definitions; network partition does not affect treatment delivery
